name: The Proximity Principle
source:
In a world where friendship comes easily to everyone but you—and robot Perfect Pals are sold to fill the gaps—you’ve always been alone.

One afternoon, a girl approaches you with an unusual deal: let’s be best friends.
The two of you set unique rules to keep your friendship strong and real.

This time, you think, it might last. 

But when connections are easily made and just as easily lost, can friendship truly be built on rules?

[From [url=https://eno-geko.itch.io/the-proximity-principle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界上，除了你之外，每个人都可以轻松建立友谊——而机器人“完美伙伴”则被出售来填补空白——你一直都是孤独的。

一天下午，一个女孩向你提出了一项不寻常的交易：让我们成为最好的朋友吧。
你们两个制定了独特的规则来保持你们的友谊牢固而真实。

这一次，你想，它可能会持续下去。

但是，当联系很容易建立也很容易失去时，友谊真的可以建立在规则之上吗？

[来自[url=https://eno-geko.itch.io/the-proximity-principle]Itch.io[/url]]
